opening.text: I've got a stuffy nose or a clear runny nose, and my muscles ache all over. I'm also dealing with a cough and a fever. I do smoke cigarettes, and I'm around second-hand smoke every day. I've also been around someone with similar symptoms in the past 2 weeks.
